s1.syndrome_frame: Rapidly enlarging breast mass in a premenarcheal girl
salient_findings: Overlying skin tense and shiny with prominent superficial veins
key_facts: No history of pain, trauma, fever, anorexia, or weight loss
Mass not fixed to skin or underlying muscle
Fine-needle aspiration cytology suggestive of fibroadenoma

raw.syndrome_frame: Rapidly enlarging breast mass in a premenarcheal girl
salient_findings: Overlying skin tense and shiny with prominent superficial veins
key_facts: No history of pain, trauma, fever, anorexia, or weight loss
Mass not fixed to skin or underlying muscle
Fine-needle aspiration cytology suggestive of fibroadenoma

differentials: Pseudoangiomatous stromal hyperplasia with giant cells
per_call: Pseudoangiomatous stromal hyperplasia with giant cells

shortlist.label: Fibroadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Ultrasonography and fine-needle aspiration cytology suggestive of fibroadenoma

shortlist.label: Phyllodes tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Rapidly enlarging breast mass in a premenarcheal girl, although less likely than fibroadenoma

shortlist.label: Giant fibroadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Large size of the breast mass, consistent with giant fibroadenoma

shortlist.label: Juvenile fibroadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Age of the patient and characteristics of the breast mass

shortlist.label: Breast hamartoma
shortlist.why_kept: Well-circumscribed, firm, and mobile nature of the breast mass

raw.rationale: The large size of the breast mass (20 cm × 20 cm) in a premenarcheal girl, combined with ultrasonography and fine-needle aspiration cytology results suggestive of fibroadenoma, points towards a giant fibroadenoma, which is a type of fibroadenoma known for its large size.

rejected.label: Fibroadenoma
rejected.why: While the pathology suggests fibroadenoma, the size of the mass is unusually large for a typical fibroadenoma, making giant fibroadenoma a more specific diagnosis.

rejected.label: Phyllodes tumor
rejected.why: Phyllodes tumors can be large but often have a more complex appearance on imaging and may exhibit malignant potential, which is not indicated in this case.

rejected.label: Juvenile fibroadenoma
rejected.why: Juvenile fibroadenoma is a consideration in young patients, but the term 'giant fibroadenoma' more accurately describes the size of the mass in this case.

rejected.label: Breast hamartoma
rejected.why: Breast hamartoma is a benign tumor-like condition, but the clinical and pathological findings are more consistent with a giant fibroadenoma.
